::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 17th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Houghton Library, Harvard University,  Eng 1635 (20)
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_471.qmd)
I enclose the proofs of your [sonnets](other_books/otherbook_434.qmd), which I should be obliged if you would forward the ensuing ones direct to me, I should be glad of those for the March number if you could kindly send them at once to my address as above

yours faithfully
C M Yonge

[on reverse]
Messrs [Mozley](organizations/other_108.qmd)[^1]
Friar Gate
Derby

---

[^1]: The cataloguer has assumed that this is the addressee, and described it as a letter to a 'Miss Moseley', but the word seems clearly to be 'Messrs'.  The author was the sister of [Margaret Gatty](people/person_549.qmd) to whom there is another letter referring to these sonnets, and also talking about where they should be sent to.
